definitions.explanation: A secret plan by a group to do something harmful or illegal, especially against an authority or rival.

examples.japanese: {陰謀|いんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{企|たくら}む。

examples.english: It is said that there was a conspiracy behind that incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陰謀|いんぼう}⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あふれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The internet is full of conspiracy theories, but many of them have no basis.

notes:
FORMS:
{陰|いん} (shadow, hidden) + {謀|ぼう} (scheme, plot) = a hidden scheme.

COMPOUNDS:
- {陰謀|いんぼう}⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧: conspiracy theory
- {陰謀|いんぼう}{論者|ろんじゃ}: conspiracy theorist

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陰謀|いんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{企|たくら}む: to plot a conspiracy
- {陰謀|いんぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{暴|あば}く→暴く：04607_abaku⟧: to expose a conspiracy
- {陰謀|いんぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be party to a conspiracy
- ⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧{陰謀|いんぼう}: political intrigue
